requirements.note: Carrier PCB matches the 55.0 x 40.0 mm CM5 outline with 3.0 mm corner radii, four M2.5 corner mounting holes 3.5 mm from edges, Lion Circuits SU-06L-0165-GDM140-001 6-layer 1.6 mm controlled-impedance stack-up (1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner copper, Diff100 0.180/0.1524 mm, Diff90 0.230/0.1524 mm), 2-up assembly panelization, and verified in-stock Lion Circuits BOM/CPL.

Compute Module 5 (excluded from the Lion PCBA BOM for final assembly) mounts underneath via two separate Amphenol 10164227-1001A1RLF 1.5 mm mezzanine connectors (J6, J7) and four 1.5 mm Wurth 9774015960R spacers (SP5-SP8), with no bottom parts exceeding 1.5 mm, no through-hole protrusions, and an 8 x 15 mm copper/part keepout across all six layers at the left board edge.

GCT USB4105-GF-A (J1) provides 5 V input and USB 2.0 OTG flashing with <=10 uF unswitched cSink, TVS2200DRVR surge protection, parallel TPS259470ARPWR soft-started ideal-diode OVP eFuses (~48 mV typ / ~110 mV max carrier drop at 3 A within the 0.25 V budget), TPD6S300ARUKR 24 V CC1/CC2 OVP/ESD protection to CM5 CC1/CC2, and ESD protection on VBUS, CC, and D+/D-.

Two horizontal surface-mount Wurth 629104190121 USB 2.0 Type-A receptacles (J2, J3) on the bottom edge are wired to CM5 USB3-0 and USB3-1 USB 2.0 pairs with AP2553W6-7 current-limited switches (U2, U3), low-ESR polymer tantalum + MLCC output bypass, and USBLC6-2SC6 ESD protection.

Full-size surface-mount Amphenol 10029449-111RLF HDMI receptacle (J4) on the right edge is driven from CM5 HDMI0 through the TPD12S016PWR companion IC (U1) with discrete low-capacitance ESD protection on DDC/CEC.

AI Camera (SC1174) is rotated 90 degrees on four Wurth 9774080243R M2x8 mm SMT spacers plus two 0.5 mm M2 washers per spacer and M2x4 nylon screws, connected via a 50 mm Wurth 686615050001 same-side FFC making a smooth >=3.0 mm radius 180-degree U-turn into the bottom-contact Amphenol SFW15R-1STE1LF socket (J5) under the camera.

Surface-mount power tactile switch SW1 (PTS526SM15SMTR2LFS) on PWR_BUT sits at (38.5, 27.6) clear of the FFC U-turn band, subminiature tactile switch SW2 (B3U-1000P) sits on nRPIBOOT beneath the front pinhole at (4.5, 10.5), UART0 SMD test pads TP1-TP3 are provided, and both the GPIO header and SD card slot are omitted as requested.

Two-part snap-fit FDM enclosure (59.0 x 44.0 x 27.5 mm) provides an unobstructed FOV lens window, captive power button and BOOT pinhole plungers, smooth internal clearance for the FFC U-turn, aligned port openings, rear M2.5 heat-set inserts, and seven CM5 cooling vent slots.

features.note: 8.0 mm circular window on the front face is centered over the AI Camera lens barrel at Z=19.75 mm and clears the full 66.3 x 52.3 deg field of view.
Captive orange power button cap on the front face aligns directly over tactile switch SW1 at board (38.5, 27.6) with its stem reaching the switch actuator.
Recessed 2.0 mm boot pinhole and captive plunger on the front face align directly over tactile switch SW2 at board (4.5, 10.5).
Right-edge USB-C cutout aligns cleanly with the GCT USB4105-GF-A receptacle mouth and center tongue facing outward.
Right-edge HDMI cutout aligns cleanly with the Amphenol 10029449-111RLF full-size HDMI receptacle mouth and contact tongue facing outward.
Bottom-edge left USB-A cutout aligns cleanly with the Wurth 629104190121 receptacle J2 mouth facing outward.
Bottom-edge right USB-A cutout aligns cleanly with the Wurth 629104190121 receptacle J3 mouth facing outward.
Seven parallel vertical rounded cooling vent slots are cut into the rear face of back_shell directly over the CM5 module.

top_differences: In render-inside.png the enclosure shells remain opaque rather than hidden, though internal board placement, actuator reach, port alignment, and stack assembly are clearly visible across render-exploded.png, render-actuators.png, and render-ports.png.

Compared to the earlier bare-board reference photos (which had an exposed PCB, 40-pin GPIO header, microSD slot, and vertical connectors), the design implements all owner-requested changes including a full two-part snap-fit FDM enclosure, horizontal edge ports, rotated AI Camera on 8 mm spacers with fold-under FFC, and removal of the GPIO header and SD slot.
